title: Azerbaijan detains former Karabakh State Minister Ruben Vardanyan at the border
body:
Azerbaijan's State Border Service announced on 27 September 2023 that it had detained Ruben Vardanyan, a Russian-Armenian businessperson and former Minister of State of Nagorno-Karabakh, as he tried to cross into Armenia. The service said Vardanyan had illegally entered Azerbaijan, citing his work as state minister, and that he had been taken to Baku, awaiting a decision from the relevant state authorities. OC Media's report placed the arrest at the Lachin checkpoint, while his wife, Veronika Zonabend, later told the RBC news outlet that he was taken while crossing the Hakari Bridge, where an Azerbaijani checkpoint had been in place since April.

Zonabend confirmed the arrest on his Twitter account that afternoon, saying he was detained at the border that morning as he tried to leave with thousands of Armenians. The Armenian government reportedly applied to the European Court of Human Rights, asking Baku to disclose his location and condition.

Karabakh president Arayik Harutyunyan had appointed Vardanyan Minister of State in November 2022, giving him authority over all ministries, and dismissed him in February 2023 citing strategic policy differences. Harutyunyan resigned in August 2023, shortly after Vardanyan demanded that he step down, and Samvel Shahramanyan succeeded him.
